title: Lockfile
description:
The `zed.lock` file written next to `zed.toml` after resolution.

Serialized as TOML with one `[[package]]` table per locked package,
Cargo.lock-style. Every entry pins the exact artifact hash and the VCS
tag it was published from, so installs are reproducible and every
artifact is traceable back to source.

ArtifactFormat.description: On-the-wire formats for published package artifacts.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the artifact archive; also its store address.

source.description: Base URL of the registry the artifact was resolved from.

vcs_tag.description: VCS tag the version was published from, e.g. `v1.2.0`.
